def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform full rows/columns are the panel dividers.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        out, start = [], 0
        for p in cuts:
            if p > start:
                out.append((start, p))
            start = p + 1
        if start < n:
            out.append((start, n))
        return out
    row_spans, col_spans = spans(h, sep_rows), spans(w, sep_cols)
    cells = [grid[r][c] for ra, rb in row_spans for ca, cb in col_spans
             for r in range(ra, rb) for c in range(ca, cb)]
    bg = max(set(cells), key=cells.count)
    other = [v for v in set(cells) if v != bg]
    mark = other[0] if other else bg
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == mark for r in range(ra, rb) for c in range(ca, cb)) == 2 else bg
             for ca, cb in col_spans] for ra, rb in row_spans]

if __name__ == '__main__':
    demo = [[8,8,8,7,8,8,8,7,8,8,8],[8,8,8,7,8,6,8,7,8,6,8],[8,8,6,7,8,6,8,7,8,8,8],[8,8,8,7,8,8,8,7,8,8,8],[8,8,8,7,8,8,8,7,8,8,8],[7]*11,[8,8,8,7,8,8,8,7,8,8,6],[8,8,8,7,8,6,8,7,8,8,8],[8,6,8,7,8,8,8,7,8,8,8],[8,8,6,7,6,8,8,7,8,8,8],[8,8,8,7,8,8,8,7,8,8,8],[7]*11,[8,8,8,7,8,8,6,7,8,8,8],[8,8,6,7,8,8,8,7,8,8,8],[8,8,8,7,8,8,6,7,8,8,6],[8,8,8,7,8,8,8,7,8,8,6],[6,8,8,7,8,8,8,7,8,8,8]]
